columns.rationale: Every sampled value is a purely numeric string (e.g. "10309", "111") and distinct_count 9057 equals row_count 9057 with null_rate 0.0, confirming id is the publisher's internal integer identifier and supports a safe INTEGER cast and use as the table's grain key.

ident is the publisher's URL identifier (the ICAO code where one exists); distinct_count 9057 equals row_count with null_rate 0.0, so it is renamed to ident_code to follow the `_code` naming convention while remaining VARCHAR text (samples include "03N", "07FA").

type carries exactly 5 distinct values (heliport, large_airport, medium_airport, seaplane_base, small_airport) with null_rate 0.0; renamed to airport_type for business clarity, kept as VARCHAR categorical text.
name has 9006 distinct values out of 9057 rows and null_rate 0.0 (e.g. "28 de Noviembre Airport"), so it is kept as the required official airport name.

latitude_deg samples show six decimal places (e.g. -79.777778) within range -79.777778 to 82.517263 and null_rate 0.0, so it is cast from the oversized DECIMAL(38,9) to DECIMAL(9,6) to match the observed precision.

longitude_deg samples show six decimal places within range -179.876999 to 179.9757 and null_rate 0.0, so it is cast from the oversized DECIMAL(38,9) to DECIMAL(10,6) to fit the wider integer-degree range.
elevation_ft samples are all whole-number values (e.g. -1266.0, -210.0) ranging -1266 to 14472 with null_rate 0.036988 (335 nulls), so it is cast to INTEGER and retained nullable rather than imputed.

continent has exactly 7 distinct two-letter values (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA) with null_rate 0.0; renamed to continent_code for the `_code` convention, noting per operator context that NA is the valid North America code, not a missing marker.

iso_country has 239 distinct ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 values (e.g. AD, AE, AF) with null_rate 0.0; renamed to iso_country_code to add the `_code` suffix, noting NA is Namibia's valid code, not a missing marker.
iso_region has 2169 distinct ISO 3166-2 values (e.g. AD-08, AE-AZ) with null_rate 0.0; renamed to iso_region_code to add the `_code` suffix per convention.
municipality has 8049 distinct values with null_rate 0.039748 (360 nulls, e.g. "108 Mile", "Aachen"), so it is kept nullable rather than imputed.

scheduled_service carries exactly the two distinct values "no" and "yes" with null_rate 0.0, so it is renamed to is_scheduled_service and cast from VARCHAR to BOOLEAN per the `is_` boolean convention.
icao_code has 7820 distinct values with null_rate 0.136579 (1237 nulls, e.g. AGAF, AGAR), so it is kept nullable since not every airport has an ICAO code.
iata_code has distinct_count 9057 equal to row_count with null_rate 0.0, consistent with this dataset being filtered to airports carrying an IATA code; kept as required VARCHAR.
gps_code has 8569 distinct values with null_rate 0.053881 (488 nulls, e.g. 03N, 05AA), so it is kept nullable.
local_code has 3193 distinct values but null_rate 0.636635 (5766 nulls), so it is kept but noted as sparsely populated rather than dropped or imputed.
home_link has 2272 distinct URL values but null_rate 0.749034 (6784 nulls, e.g. "http://GillespieField.com/"), so it is kept but noted as sparsely populated.
wikipedia_link has 7870 distinct URL values with null_rate 0.130838 (1185 nulls), so it is kept nullable.
keywords has 2883 distinct comma-separated phrase values but null_rate 0.679585 (6155 nulls), so it is kept but noted as sparsely populated; no truncation markers were observed in the sampled values.
is_airbyte_metadata is true for _airbyte_raw_id, marking it a capture-tool artifact with no business meaning, so it is dropped.
is_airbyte_metadata is true for _airbyte_extracted_at, a capture-pipeline timestamp with only 2 distinct values, so it is dropped.
is_airbyte_metadata is true for _airbyte_meta, which carries a single constant value "{}" across all 9057 rows, so it is dropped.

decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 9057, so no exact-duplicate removal logic is needed.
id has distinct_count 9057 equal to row_count 9057 and null_rate 0.0, making it the smallest defensible grain key for one row per airport.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and no business meaning, so all three are dropped.
scheduled_service's distinct_values are exactly ["no","yes"] with null_rate 0.0, supporting a strict cast to BOOLEAN under the is_scheduled_service name.
ident, continent, iso_country, and iso_region are renamed to ident_code, continent_code, iso_country_code, and iso_region_code to follow the operator's `_code` suffix convention for code columns.

continent's distinct_values include "NA" for North America and iso_country's samples include "NA" for Namibia; per operator context these are valid codes, not missing markers, so no special null handling is applied.
local_code (null_rate 0.636635), home_link (null_rate 0.749034), and keywords (null_rate 0.679585) are all retained nullable rather than dropped or imputed despite high null rates.
elevation_ft samples are all whole-number values (e.g. -1266.0, up to 14472) so the landed DECIMAL(38,9) is cast to INTEGER.
latitude_deg and longitude_deg samples show at most six decimal places, so the landed DECIMAL(38,9) is cast to DECIMAL(9,6) and DECIMAL(10,6) respectively to match observed precision.

purpose: silver_airports provides one cleaned row per OurAirports airport record (this extract limited to airports carrying an IATA code), feeding downstream airport-reference joins for routes, weather, and geospatial analytics.
usage: Join on id (the unique grain key), or on iata_code/icao_code/gps_code/local_code as alternate lookup keys; treat continent_code and iso_country_code value "NA" as the valid North America / Namibia codes rather than a missing marker; filter or coalesce nullable columns (elevation_ft, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, keywords) deliberately since nulls are retained rather than imputed.
limitations: local_code (63.66% null), home_link (74.90% null), and keywords (67.96% null) remain sparsely populated and were not backfilled; icao_code (13.66% null) and gps_code (5.39% null) are not available for every airport; duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 so no dedupe logic was applied, and lat/long precision was reduced from the landed DECIMAL(38,9) based on observed sample precision rather than a documented spec.
